title: Тексты: читаем и переводим
subtitle: короткие тексты по темам курса, вопросы на понимание и перевод

sections.title: About me
sections.theory:
Прочитайте текст. Незнакомые слова — в списке под ним. Потом ответьте на вопросы и переведите предложения.

Marina, 29

Hello! My name's Marina and I'm from Kazan. I'm 29 years old and I'm a nurse. I work in a small hospital near my house.

I live with my husband and our daughter. Her name's Vera and she's six. My husband is an engineer. He's from Samara, so he's Russian too.

My favourite month is May, because the weather is warm and my birthday is on the 12th of May. I'm interested in photography, but I'm not very good at it!

Новые слова

  • a nurse — медсестра
  • a hospital — больница
  • a husband — муж
  • a daughter — дочь
  • because — потому что
  • warm — тёплый
  • good at — хорош в чём-то
Связь с курсомУрок 1: to be, страны и национальности · Урок 2: чьё это · Урок 4: месяцы

items.ex: I'm from Kazan, I work near my house.

items.q: Her daughter is six years old.
items.ex: Her name's Vera and she's six.
I'm not very good at it.
my birthday is on the 12th of May.

a: My name's Marina and I'm from Kazan.
My name is Marina and I am from Kazan.
My name is Marina, I'm from Kazan.
I'm a nurse.
I am a nurse.
My husband is an engineer.
My husband's an engineer.
My birthday is in May.

sections.title: Our flat
sections.theory:
Our flat

We live in a small flat on the fourth floor. There are three rooms: a living room, a bedroom and a kitchen.

There's a big sofa in the living room and a lamp next to it. Our TV is on the wall, opposite the sofa. There isn't a table in this room, so we have dinner in the kitchen.

Our building is near the metro station. There are two supermarkets and a pharmacy in front of the house, but there aren't any cafés in our street. That's the only problem!

Новые слова

  • a floor — этаж
  • a wall — стена
  • a building — здание
  • the only — единственный
  • a problem — проблема
Связь с курсомУрок 9: there is / there are и предлоги места

items.q: They live on the fourth floor.
There is a table in the living room.
items.ex: There isn't a table in this room.

items.q: There are cafés in their street.
items.ex: There aren't any cafés in our street.

items.q: The building is near the metro.
items.ex: Our building is near the metro station.

items.q: How many rooms are there in the flat?

o: On the wall, opposite the sofa.
items.a: On the wall, opposite the sofa.
items.ex: Our TV is on the wall, opposite the sofa.
we have dinner in the kitchen.

a: There are three rooms in the flat.
There are three rooms in the apartment.
There is a lamp next to the sofa.
There's a lamp next to the sofa.
There aren't any cafés in our street.
There are not any cafes in our street.
There aren't any cafes in our street.

sections.title: Sergey's day
sections.theory:
Sergey, a taxi driver

Sergey is a taxi driver in Moscow. He works five days a week and he starts work at two o'clock in the afternoon.

He gets up at ten, has a shower and makes breakfast for his family. Then he takes his son to school. He doesn't have lunch at home — he usually eats a sandwich in the car.

Sergey finishes work at midnight. He gets home at about one o'clock and watches TV for half an hour. He goes to bed at two. He likes his job, but he doesn't like the traffic.

Новые слова

  • a taxi driver — таксист
  • midnight — полночь
  • half an hour — полчаса
  • traffic — пробки, движение
Связь с курсомУрок 4: привычки · Урок 5: -s у he / she / it и распорядок дня

items.q: Sergey starts work in the morning.
items.ex: He starts work at two in the afternoon.
He doesn't have lunch at home.

items.q: He takes his son to school.
items.ex: Then he takes his son to school.

items.q: He goes to bed at two.
items.ex: He goes to bed at two.

items.q: What time does he get up?
Where does he usually eat lunch?
items.ex: he usually eats a sandwich in the car.

a: He works five days a week.
He doesn't have lunch at home.
He does not have lunch at home.
What time does he finish work?
When does he finish work?
items.ex: What time + does + he + finish work?

sections.title: Last weekend
sections.theory:
A message from a friend

Hi! How was your weekend? Mine was great.

On Saturday morning I got up late and had a big breakfast. Then I met my friends in the centre and we went to a new café. The coffee was excellent, but the cake wasn't very good.

In the evening we watched a film at home. I didn't go out on Sunday, because the weather was terrible. I stayed at home and read a book. What did you do?

Новые слова

  • mine — мой (без предмета)
  • the centre — центр города
  • excellent — отличный
  • terrible — ужасный
  • to stay — оставаться
Связь с курсомУрок 7: was / were, -ed, неправильные глаголы, didn't

items.q: He got up early on Saturday.
The coffee in the café was good.

items.ex: I didn't go out on Sunday.

items.q: The weather was bad on Sunday.
Where did he meet his friends?
items.ex: I met my friends in the centre.

items.q: What did they do in the evening?
items.ex: we watched a film at home.

items.q: Why didn't he go out on Sunday?

a: How was your weekend?
We went to a new café.
We went to a new cafe.

items.q: «В воскресенье я не выходил из дома.»
a: I didn't go out on Sunday.
I did not go out on Sunday.
The weather was terrible.

sections.title: In a café
sections.theory:
A conversation

— Good morning! What would you like?

— Good morning. Can I have a coffee and a cheese sandwich, please?

— Sure. Would you like anything else?

— Yes, I'd like a bottle of water too. And can you tell me the wi-fi password?

— Of course, it's on the menu. That's £8.40, please.

— Here you are. Thank you!

Новые слова

  • a password — пароль
  • of course — конечно
  • anything else — что-нибудь ещё
  • Here you are — вот, пожалуйста
Связь с курсомУрок 10: Can I…? и Can you…? · Урок 12: I'd like и цены

items.ex: I'd like a bottle of water too.

items.q: The wi-fi password is on the menu.

o: Can I have a coffee, please?
items.a: Can I have a coffee, please?

a: Can I have a coffee and a sandwich, please?
items.ex: Can I have + a coffee and a sandwich.

a: I'd like a bottle of water.
I would like a bottle of water.
items.ex: I'd like + a bottle of water.

a: How much is that?
How much is it?
How much is that altogether?

sections.title: A letter from Nick
sections.theory:
Nick, 34, London

Hi! I'm Nick and I live in London with my wife and two children. I work as a journalist, so I write a lot every day.

We've got a small house near a park. There's a garden behind the house and my children love playing there. Right now they are playing football with our dog!

I usually get up at seven, but last Saturday I got up at eleven, because we had a party on Friday night. It was my wife's birthday. We didn't cook — we ordered pizza and watched films.

I can't cook very well, but I can make good coffee. Come and visit us — I'd like to show you the city!

Новые слова

  • a wife — жена
  • to order — заказывать
  • to show — показать
  • Come and visit us — приезжайте в гости

Этот текст собран из всех тем курса: to be, have got, there is, Present Simple и Continuous, Past Simple, can и I'd like.

items.q: He has got a big flat.
His children are playing football now.
items.ex: Right now they are playing football.

items.q: They cooked dinner for the party.
items.ex: We didn't cook — we ordered pizza.

items.q: «I work as a journalist» — это про…
«I can make good coffee» — это про…

a: We've got a small house.
We have got a small house.
We have a small house.
There is a garden behind the house.
There's a garden behind the house.

items.q: «В прошлую субботу я встал в одиннадцать.»
a: Last Saturday I got up at eleven.
I got up at eleven last Saturday.
I can't cook very well.
I cannot cook very well.
I can't cook well.
I'd like to show you the city.
I would like to show you the city.
